gloss: to firmly believe, to be convinced

definitions.gloss: to firmly believe, to be convinced, to be under the impression
definitions.explanation: To believe something completely without doubt, often regardless of whether it is actually true.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{噂|うわさ}を{信|しん}じ{込|こ}んでいる。
{自分|じぶん}が{正|ただ}しいと{信|しん}じ{込|こ}んでいた。
examples.english: I was convinced that I was right.

examples.japanese: {詐欺師|さぎし}の{話|はなし}を{信|しん}じ{込|こ}んでお{金|かね}を{騙|だま}し{取|と}られた。
examples.english: I believed the scammer's story completely and was cheated out of money.

notes:
{信|しん}じ{込|こ}む is a compound verb with ～{込|こ}む adding the sense of thoroughness or completion.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
- Pattern: Xを{信|しん}じ{込|こ}む / Xと{信|しん}じ{込|こ}む

ASPECT (ている):
- {信|しん}じ{込|こ}んでいる: is firmly convinced (state)

NUANCE:
Often implies blind or possibly mistaken belief. More emphatic than {信|しん}じる alone.

COMPOSITION:
- {信|しん}じる: to believe
- ～{込|こ}む: suffix adding completeness/thoroughness
